claims.title: Actuator repair: expose the working wall and renew the backing

quoted_fields.interface: Guided rolling actuator with nominal38um film,52mm piston,60mm guide,4mm rolling gap,22mm useful stroke and two paid service overtravels. Retain customer load with a separate brake/catch, vent, park captive cap, enforce actual unloaded folds, place/hold/heat/cool a generic lap patch, expose and clean worked backing, withdraw all tools, then prove useful loaded work and renewed access. Admitted missing-material geometry and loose dust envelope are finite; arbitrary cavities, oils, cuff cuts and machinery damage are excluded.
quoted_fields.failure: No19/20 accepted hardware repairs or100-hour self-maintenance demonstration. Parent tensile strength is not repaired-film fatigue or weld toughness; pressure/force passes do not identify buried weak bonds. Fold following, release coating, camera localization and tool recovery are actual missing operations. A few grams of prepared spare films challenge inventory/mass claims. Current model cost is15.7% higher per potential work than the strongest exchanger; no30% or threefold whole-system advantage. ROOT stiffness/strain screens are introduced small-strain diagnostics, not a TPU failure prediction.
